reason: The hypothesis combines the known problem of Cr-Zr interdiffusion in Cr-coated Zr cladding (P1, P2) with the demonstrated effectiveness of ultrathin ALD Al2O3 diffusion barriers in a completely different metal system (Cu-Au, P36, P39). None of the passages propose or test an ALD interlayer for Cr-coated Zr alloys, making this a non-trivial transfer of a nanoscale barrier concept to a new material system with a stated mechanistic rationale.
